title: 第28章 虐杀
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
灵骨守卫抬起骨手，朝克莱恩的方向虚点了一下。

    “登台。”

    克莱恩的身体不由自主地飘了起来。

    他拼命挣扎，手脚在空中胡乱挥舞，嘴里发出惊恐的喊叫：“不！我不要！放开我！我认输！我反悔！”

    灵骨守卫不为所动。

    那无形的力量托着克莱恩，缓缓飘向生死台。他的挣扎越来越剧烈，声音都变了调，尖利得像是被掐住脖子的公鸡。

    “我是五等资质！我是温莎家族的继承人！你不能杀我！你们不能杀我！”

    没有人理会他。

    伊森看着他那个狼狈的模样，嘴角扯了扯。

    “废物。”

    他抬脚朝生死台走去。

    克莱恩被那股力量扔进生死台的光罩内，整个人摔在冰冷的石台上，瘫软成一团。他蜷缩在台面中央，浑身剧烈颤抖，嘴里还在断断续续地念叨着什么。

    此时，周围已经围满了人。

    那些从教学区、宿舍区赶来的学生，有的站在远处观望，有的挤在近处，三三两两议论纷纷。

    “那是谁？新生？”

    “天才区的吧，看着面生。”

    “对面那个瘫了的也是新生？这就上生死台了？”

    “听说是克莱恩·温莎，温莎家族的。今年新生的五等资质之一。”

    “五等资质？五等还上生死台？”

    “啧啧，这下有好戏看了。”

    伊森没有理会那些议论声，只是缓步走向生死台。

    他踏上石台的边缘，跨过那层暗红色的光罩。光罩如同水幕一般，在他身体穿过时泛起一圈涟漪，随即恢复平静。

    灵骨守卫的声音在广场上回荡开来：

    “契约双方登台完毕，可随时开始。”

    伊森站在生死台上，低头看着瘫软在台面中央的克莱恩。

    克莱恩蜷缩在那里，浑身抖得像筛糠。他的袍子已经被冷汗浸透，脸上没有半点血色，嘴唇翕动着，发出含糊不清的声音。

    “我......我是五等......我是温莎......你不能......”

    伊森没有说话。

    他抬脚，朝克莱恩走去。

    每一步都不快，每一步都很稳。

    克莱恩看着那个越来越近的身影，瞳孔缩成针尖大小。

    “不......不要......”

    伊森走到他面前，低头俯视着他。

    那目光依旧平静。

    没有愤怒，没有杀意，甚至没有怜悯。

    只有一种近乎冷漠的平静。

    然后，他抬起右脚。

    “咔嚓！”

    克莱恩的小腿骨在伊森脚下碎裂，发出一声清脆的爆响。

    “啊！”
content_en:
The spirit bone guard raised his bone hand and nodded in the direction of Klein.

    "Go on stage."

    Klein's body floated involuntarily.

    He struggled desperately, waving his hands and feet in the air, shouting in horror: "No! I don't want it! Let me go! I admit defeat! I regret it!"

    The spirit bone guards remained unmoved.

    The invisible force supported Klein and slowly floated towards the stage of life and death. His struggle became more and more intense, and his voice changed its pitch, becoming as sharp as a cock being strangled.

    "I have a fifth-level qualification! I am the heir to the Windsor family! You can't kill me! You can't kill me!"

    No one paid any attention to him.

    Ethan looked at his embarrassed appearance and twitched the corners of his mouth.

    "Trash."

    He raised his feet and walked towards the stage of life and death.

    Klein was thrown into the light barrier of the life and death platform by that force, and his whole body fell onto the cold stone platform, paralyzing into a ball. He was curled up in the middle of the countertop, his whole body shaking violently, and he was still mumbling something intermittently.

    At this time, there were already people around.

    Among the students who came from the teaching area and dormitory area, some stood watching from a distance, while others crowded close by, talking in groups.

    "Who's that? Freshman?"

    "He's from the genius area, he looks familiar."

    "The paralyzed person opposite is also a freshman? Is he now on the stage of life and death?"

    "I heard it's Klein Windsor, from the Windsor family. One of the fifth-class qualifications for this year's freshmen."

    "Fifth-level qualifications? Are you still going to the stage of life and death at the fifth level?"

    "Tsk, tsk, now we have something good to watch."

    Ethan ignored the comments and just walked slowly towards the life and death platform.

    He stepped onto the edge of the stone platform and stepped across the dark red light barrier. The light shield was like a water curtain, creating a circle of ripples when his body passed through it, and then returned to calm.

    The voice of the spirit bone guard echoed in the square:

    "Both parties to the contract have finished taking the stage and can start at any time."

    Ethan stood on the stage of life and death, looking down at Klein who was slumped in the center of the stage.

    Klein huddled there, shaking like chaff. His robe was soaked with cold sweat, his face was bloodless, and his lips were moving, making inarticulate sounds.

    "I...I am fifth class...I am Windsor...you can't..."

    Ethan said nothing.

    He raised his feet and walked towards Klein.

    Every step is not fast, every step is steady.

    Klein looked at the figure getting closer and closer, his pupils shrinking to the size of a pinhead.

    "No...don't..."

    Ethan walked up to him and looked down at him.

    That look was still calm.

    There was no anger, no murderous intent, not even pity.

    There is only an almost indifferent calm.

    Then he lifted his right foot.

    "Crack!"

    Klein's calf bone shattered under Ethan's feet, making a crisp explosion.

    "ah!"
